text.title: Architect Skill Index (Geek Tier) — Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 known failure modes of a curated architect skill index. Each carries a detector (what to look for) and a repair (the corrective action).

failure-mode.description: Dangling links: entries point at slugs that were renamed, merged or never existed, so the architect opens the index and lands on nothing.
failure-mode.detector: Script resolves every `[[slug]]` against `skills/faion/knowledge/*/<slug>/meta.json`; any miss, or any target with `status` other than `active`.
failure-mode.repair: Re-point or remove each failing entry in the same review; add the resolver script to the pre-merge check for the index.

failure-mode.description: Copied summary: the "architect why" is the target's own one-sentence summary, so the index adds no architectural angle.
failure-mode.detector: Diff each `architect_why` against the target `meta.json` `summary`; high textual overlap, or no architecture task named in the sentence.
failure-mode.repair: Rewrite the sentence to name the architecture task (boundary decision, ADR, fitness function, review) the entry serves; reject entries where no such task can be named.

failure-mode.description: Tool-named clusters: sections are "spec-kit", "plan-mode", "RAG", so the reader must already know which tool solves their task.
failure-mode.detector: Cluster names match source tool or feature names rather than architecture activities; a task such as "review a cross-cutting change" has no obvious cluster.
failure-mode.repair: Re-cluster by architecture activity (elicit, decide and record, document views, evaluate and review, govern drift); merge any cluster with fewer than three entries.

failure-mode.description: Padding: the same methodology is listed under several clusters, or entries with no architectural angle are added, purely to reach 50.
failure-mode.detector: Duplicate slugs across clusters; entries whose `architect_why` is generic ("useful for architects"); count exactly 50 with several borderline entries.
failure-mode.repair: Deduplicate to one cluster per slug, delete entries with no nameable architecture task, and report the true count with the uncovered tasks listed.

failure-mode.description: No load signal: entries lack `load_when` and `est_tokens`, so an agent either loads every target or none.
failure-mode.detector: Entries missing either field; `est_tokens` values that differ from the target's `meta.json`.
failure-mode.repair: Add an observable trigger per entry and copy `est_tokens` from the target; fail the index validator when either field is absent.

failure-mode.description: Implied completeness: the index has no "not covered" section, so the architect hunts for an entry that does not exist and distrusts the tier.
failure-mode.detector: No final section listing uncovered architecture tasks; support questions of the form "where is the methodology for X" that the index could have answered with "none yet".
failure-mode.repair: Add the uncovered-tasks section with the closest partial match per task; review it at the same cadence as the links.
